firstPlayerRule: The dealer makes the first call in the auction. After bidding, the defender on the declarer’s left makes the opening lead.
houseFallback: The page does not say how the first dealer is chosen; use the picker.

sources.title: Bridge — How to Play
sources.publisher: Bicycle Cards (The United States Playing Card Company)

internalEvidence: Read the Bicycle Cards Bridge page in a browser. "Calls - Once the cards are dealt, each player picks up their hand and, beginning with the dealer, makes a call (pass, bid, double or redouble)." "For the first trick, the defender on the declarer’s left makes the first lead (the opening lead)."
uncertainty: The page does not say how the first dealer is chosen.
